project_overview: This project appears to be a Vue.js application focused on educational services, likely related to student enrollment, exam management, and results. It utilizes a modular architecture with several Vue components organized into different sections. The dependency graph reveals a clear routing structure and potential reliance on a central application services component. The project seems to lean heavily on Vue components for UI presentation and navigation.

layers.description: Responsible for the user interface and user interactions.
Contains the core application logic and rules.

macro_trends.title: Potential Centralized Application Services Component
macro_trends.description: The 'SelectedApplicationService.vue' component appears to be a central point of interaction for several other components, potentially leading to a single point of failure or increased coupling. This warrants investigation for modularity and testability.

macro_trends.title: Prop Drilling Concerns
macro_trends.description: The extensive use of Router push operations suggests a potential reliance on prop drilling for passing data between components. This can lead to code complexity and reduced maintainability. Consider using Vuex or a similar state management solution for more complex state handling.

key_workflows.name: Exam Submission Workflow
key_workflows.description: The dependency chain from ExamFormSubmission.vue to FeeDetails.vue, Transactions.vue, and potentially ResultPage.vue represents a core workflow for managing exam submissions and processing related data. This workflow needs careful monitoring for performance and potential bottlenecks.

key_workflows.name: Student Profile Navigation
key_workflows.description: The routing flow involving iLikeDashboard.vue and related components indicates a pathway for students to explore courses and learning materials. Optimization of this navigation is essential for a positive user experience.
